preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 5000.
The size of the table is between 2x2 and 100x100.

preconditions.expression: The sum of nm for all test cases does not exceed 20000.
preconditions.description: The total number of cells in all tables does not exceed 20000.

postconditions.description: The number of operations is between 0 and 3 times the total number of cells in all tables.

postconditions.expression: Each operation affects 3 different cells in a 2x2 square.
postconditions.description: Each operation changes the value of 3 cells from 0 to 1 or from 1 to 0.

postconditions.expression: All cells in the table are eventually set to 0.
postconditions.description: The table is transformed by the operations to contain only 0s.

invariants.expression: The operations are performed in a sequence that guarantees all cells will be set to 0.
invariants.description: The sequence of operations ensures that each cell is flipped the correct number of times to achieve the final state of 0.
